architecture.summary: This candidate repairs live acceptance expectations for the existing Slice 1 portal. No production file changes. Unassigned and unauthorized accounts must reach the exact organization selector with a signed-in session; tests still check the root portal refusal and protected 403 responses. Successful product details must be opened before visible text is read. No authorization, runtime contract, provider adapter, persistence, composition, dependency, or deployment behavior changes. The Staging release record describes the authorized password-only test profile and observations of the unchanged production candidate; it does not define new product behavior or approve legal wording or signup opening. All 11 component registry diagrams remain byte-for-byte unchanged. Context, hosted and local containers/components, runtime landing/member/tool scenarios, and deployment views remain accurate. Source metrics are not selected because only live tests, their support, ordinary documentation, and this declaration change. No production callable contract changed; no L4 drawing or decision record is needed.
